Abel_error: enclosed Gaussian difference to the analytic Abel value for all 1089 histories, followed by analytic absolute dust bound
boundary_measure: one half times the two labelled point measures, each with Lebesgue dq
composition_basis: unweighted labelled Hermite/Legendre product basis for conditional regulated seam functions; no premature seam-only invariant projection
composition_error: absolute sesquilinear amplitude error, including all coherent combinations
composition_state_class: both outer inputs in the H-unit ball of the original four-state span E4
error_bounds: spectral differential whole-tail bounds, exact polynomial moments, triangle/Jensen estimates over full finite history sums
excluded_claims: compact reduction certified at tolerance 0.01 within 1e6 modes
model: original 33 labelled AA histories; their 1089 minimal transitive sewings
relative_error: not uniform: two exact H-normalized null combinations exist
retained_cut_memory: all data required by prior_sewing_contract.json, including earlier fields; cross influence retained before integration
single_basis: weighted Hermite total degree N, separate atom plus positive-density Legendre degree D, clock Legendre degree L; invariant simultaneous point swap
single_kernel_error: absolute Vprime response error, equivalently supremum over the entire V test unit ball; both pairing directions
single_kernel_state_class: C_M={f in V: norm_H(f)<=1, norm_V(f)<=sqrt(261)}, with individual bounds for all four inputs and their coherent H-unit ball
single_response_basis: weighted dual modes; not the test modes themselves
stopping_rule: HOLD_RESOURCE_CAP if mode count exceeds cap
otherwise TOLERANCE_PASS only if analytic + certified numerical error < tolerance
